original_test_intent: Enable DHCP on the intended BMC management interface and prove that the same BMC receives a valid approved lease and remains securely reachable.
original_method: Bind BMC MAC/channel/interface and baseline network state, enable DHCP once by documented IPMI or Web UI control, correlate the server lease, rediscover by immutable identity and verify authenticated management reachability.
manual_activity: The network owner approves the DHCP scope, channel/interface, maintenance window and rollback; an operator maintains OOB access and confirms same-BMC identity after the address transition.
required_inputs: BMC identity, MAC, LAN channel/interface and current address
Approved VLAN, DHCP server/scope/reservation and lease visibility
Protected credentials and trusted management path
Known-good static rollback and console/OOB access
safety_requirements: Do not assume old IP or eth0 remains authoritative
Protect credentials and validate TLS/host identity
Stop on identity mismatch or lost reachability
Do not toggle or reset blindly
agent_execution_scope: Rediscover same BMC by MAC/identity and authenticate
Collect lease, route, link and event evidence without autonomous recovery or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Post-change Redfish fields may corroborate DHCP, but the command assumes eth0/current IP, skips TLS validation and never enables DHCP or proves same-device rediscovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented channel-specific DHCP write once, correlate the DHCP lease by MAC and verify the authenticated same BMC on its new address.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DHCP mode, IPMI/Web UI alternatives, LAN print intent, scripts and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure same-BMC discovery, infrastructure evidence and rollback controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reading a preselected Redfish endpoint cannot prove a DHCP mutation or lease transition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong channel/VLAN or missing lease can strand BMC management and dependent automation.

project_override_considerations: The project may use IPMI, Web UI or supported Redfish configuration, but must preserve exact interface identity, one transition, DHCP-server lease evidence and OOB rollback.
expected_evidence: Approval, BMC/MAC/channel/interface and pre-change network baseline
Timestamped lease assignment matched to MAC/identity
Authenticated same-BMC reachability and effective DHCPv4/address/link state
Events, rollback/recovery if any and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria, bundle and scripts all describe DHCP configuration; DeepSeek is incomplete rather than source-conflicting.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Channel, DHCP scope, discovery and rollback are finite normal network inputs, enabling conditional execution.

review_improvement: Converts a read-only presumed endpoint check into the actual DHCP transition with MAC-bound lease and secure same-BMC reachability proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Changing a BMC address can sever the only management path. Therefore mutation must be owner-approved and recoverable, while a lease tied to immutable MAC plus authenticated rediscovery is the meaningful success oracle.
